$comment: Shared by tech-lead, test-engineer, developer, code-reviewer and auditor —
Nothing here grants a write scope. That comes from ORCH_ROLE plus
hooks/write-scope.sh, and for the developer and test-engineer from
`isolation: worktree`, which the platform enforces harder than any settings
glob. What this file does is deny every path to the base branch. Invariant 1
says exactly one candidate diff reaches it at a time, and the only role that
gets there is the director, through the human gate.
Bash(mkdir:*) is allowed because a test-engineer writing the first test in a
project usually has to create the directory that holds it, and a role that
must stop and ask for that is a role that will instead put the test
somewhere it is allowed to write.
